note: A minute that doesn't move (round long-main, his ear 11-04 on Drive - Cloudburst's next theme: 'essentially the same minimalistic development going on for 1 minute straight, with some fluctuation through our drum work'; on the sketches, the half-break 'is a lot better', the harmony's departures and the bass's walk out). Where a beat-led theme runs 32 bars or 45 s with no change above the drums (`staticRuns`, src/long-main.ts), the theme's own die may answer it by form: an eight-bar half-break at the phrase line nearest the run's middle, taken out of the main (the theme keeps its length), and where the stretch left is still a run, the build into the drop or a second half-break. The slow places (under leastBpm) and a run without the kick keep their stillness; Loom keeps about one run in two still at its top.

leans.says: the one lean (src/lean.ts) on the chance a static run develops, about the house's centre: a static run develops unless Loom (the loop, the hypnotic hold) asks to hold it: about one in two still at full Loom

form.says: the half-break: eight bars at the phrase line nearest the run's middle (drawn among the lines within `near` bars of it), the grammar's breakdown a phrase long; its way in at most `lead` bars before it, as the second plan leads into it; a second move where the stretch left is still a run: the build into the drop (its last eight or sixteen bars) where the main runs into one, else a second half-break
